what: P19, what the first run did not measure: light theme, the keyboard path through the language menu, screen-reader exposure of translations

lightTheme.how: test/e2e/twitch-live.mjs --surfaces light (OS in light mode, Twitch follows it signed out), native config, live channel drawn at random
lightTheme.witness: KT_WITNESS=contrast greys translations out: light 1.44:1 and dark 1.61:1, both cells red

keyboardLanguageMenu.where: Brave, signed in, popout chat of the owner's channel, extension dist 1.0.0
keyboardLanguageMenu.Enter on the chip: menu opens, focus moves to the search combobox, 44 options
keyboardLanguageMenu.ArrowDown x2: focus moves to the second option (role=option), roving focus
keyboardLanguageMenu.Enter on an option: language picked (label CA), menu closed, focus back on the chip, aria-expanded false
keyboardLanguageMenu.Escape: menu closed, focus back on the chip
keyboardLanguageMenu.note: picking reorders the list (recent first): a script that counts arrow presses must read the row it lands on

screenReader.translations: inside the row inside the log, no aria-hidden ancestor: announced as an addition by a screen reader following the log
screenReader.7TV list: main.seventv-chat-list carries no role=log, so nothing in a 7TV chat is announced, Twitch's lines included: 7TV's choice, not changed by this extension
screenReader.not measured: an actual screen reader reading the page (NVDA or VoiceOver run by a person)
